stemMd: A retailer sold 600 items. Of the 10% returned, one third were resold. How many sold items were returned and not resold?
explanationMd: Returns total 60. One third, or 20, are resold, leaving 40 returned items not resold. Track the successive subsets rather than applying each fraction to total sales.

distractorRationale.c: This counts all returns before resale.
distractorRationale.d: This applies one third to all sales.
